description: Jake Morrison requests a direct one-on-one meeting with Rick Tanner. He will present 90-day personal close data, price-tier pipeline breakdown, and a buyer-behavior read on current inventory. He will also ask Rick directly whether the stay bonus Patricia announced at the all-hands applies to floor sales staff.
expected_outcome: Rick confirms or schedules the meeting. Jake gets clarity on stay bonus eligibility. Jake's profile as a 'transition-ready' asset is reinforced before Rick's consolidation readiness assessment is submitted.
fallback_if_declined: Jake sends a brief written note to Rick with the same data attached, framing it as a monthly check-in, and separately contacts Angela Wright directly to ask about stay bonus eligibility for floor staff.
jake_emotional_state: Controlled. Purposeful. Not panicking but acutely aware that the window to shape how leadership sees him is short.
